description: Product/base decisions for the remote-image watch rows: per row, the exact missing image, where it fails, whether both Helm and ConfigHub fail, a candidate override path (or unknown), and a recommended product action + owner class. Read-only projection over committed receipts and decision surfaces. Generated by scripts/generate-remote-image-runtime-workdown.mjs; do not hand-edit.

rows.current_off_ramp: Resolve the image by digest, override to a maintained image, or refresh the catalog base with a pullable image, then rerun the live lane.
rows.next_action: Refresh the catalog base to a chart version whose pinned image still exists upstream, or pin a retained digest; the current pinned tag(s) were removed from the publisher registry.
